item.title: Roman Catholic Diocese of Amarillo announces death of Monsignor Rex Nicholl
item.description: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Amarillo announced Monsignor Rex Nicholl, its senior priest, died Wednesday at the age of 89. Funeral arrangements were pending as of Thursday.

item.title: Olympic Zone for Wednesday Feb. 11, 2026
item.description: On the Olympic Zone for Wednesday Feb. 12, we take a look at Team USA's historic performances in multiple sports, a mother balancing family and bobsledding, a look at the Milan's fashion and more.

item.title: United Way of Amarillo & Canyon highlights 2025 community impact, donors
item.description: The United Way of Amarillo & Canyon is highlighting the 2025 fundraising campaign and releasing the Community Status Report during a private event with community partners.

item.title: 2 indicted in shooting that left 15-year-old girl dead in Amarillo
item.description: Two teenagers were indicted in a January shooting that left a 15-year-old girl dead, according to court documents that were filed in Potter County.

item.title: Canadian Middle School earns statewide honors
item.description: Officials with Canadian ISD announced that its middle school will be receiving statewide honors for outstanding achievement.

item.title: Bipartisan push in U.S. House to create new visa program, help home builders who rely on immigrant workers
item.description: The South Texas Builders Association said construction sites are seeing fewer workers because of immigration enforcement and it's costing Americans big dollars.

item.title: Unofficial results from 2026 CMS Special Election show voters chose no on Capital Improvement Act Tax
item.description: According to unofficial results from the Wednesday 2026 CMS Special Election, voters said no to renewing the Capital Improvement Act Tax for Clovis Municipal Schools.

item.title: Olympic Zone for Thursday Feb. 12, 2026
item.description: On the Olympic Zone for Wednesday Feb. 12 we look at the best moments from Tuesday, a deep dive into snowboarding, the warmup regimen for an Olympic figure skater, and more.

item.title: Multiple fire departments respond to grass fire in Beaver County Tuesday
item.description: The Oklahoma Forestry Service reported the "Flat Tire Fire" in Beaver County had impacted about 5,000 acres and was approximately 25% contained as of Wednesday morning.
